historical_implementation.rng: std::mt19937 seeded from time(nullptr), std::shuffle, and modulo neighbor selection
known_contract_breaks: allocation and blocked-cell insertion failures were not reported

correction.rng: shared Maze PCG32 generation context using bounded draws
correction.failure_model: checked maze creation, checked blocking, cancellation, step limits, and exception barriers
correction.legacy_compatibility: Preserve the corrected algorithm and make maze_make_hunt_and_kill an ABI 1.x adapter to the canonical status API.

phase_contract.start: uniformly select one odd/odd logical cell and mark it visited
phase_contract.kill: shuffle four directions and carve to the first valid unvisited neighbor
phase_contract.hunt: scan odd/odd logical cells in row-major order, select the first unvisited cell adjacent to the tree, and uniformly select one visited attachment neighbor
phase_contract.progress_invariant: Every successful kill or hunt carve adds exactly one previously unvisited logical vertex and one edge to the existing tree.
phase_contract.termination: On the connected rectangular logical lattice, no eligible hunt cell exists only after every logical vertex has joined the tree.

hunt_policy_decision.reason: ABI 1 exposes one supported policy; add a typed policy only when a second behavior is implemented and tested.

requirements: all odd/odd logical cells are passages
edge count equals logical node count minus one

stage2_decision.required_followup: Expose the checked generator, enforce the visited-count postcondition, and document replay, topology, failure, ownership, and cancellation contracts.
